card.name: Opioid-benzodiazepine warning sentence linking words
card.fires_on: The small words "of" and "that" in the boxed-warning sentence "Observational studies have demonstrated that concomitant use of opioid analgesics and benzodiazepines...". It fires right after "concomitant use" or "demonstrated".

modes.label: "of" after concomitant use
modes.description: The word "of" directly after "concomitant use", just before opioid analgesics and benzodiazepines.
modes.example: Observational studies have demonstrated that concomitant use<< of>> opioid analgesics and benzodiaz

modes.label: "that" after demonstrated
modes.description: The word "that" after "Observational studies have demonstrated", before concomitant use.
modes.example: Observational studies have demonstrated<< that>> concomitant use of opioid analges

card.plain: It marks a linking word in the standard warning about taking opioids and benzodiazepines together.
